notes: These are sample records for the estimate demo, not production Workday activity. Activity fields map to current GoDocent collection.
Names, emails and phone numbers are placeholders. No source contact details are embedded.
Page, prospect and row IDs are local adapter join keys, not exported GoDocent IDs.
Dates have day precision only. Time of day, timezone, page URLs, video IDs and button records are not supplied.
Anonymous events have no visitor ID. They support aggregate page, action and date counts, not individual histories or unique visitor counts. Anonymous ID tracking is deferred.
Publication and report tokens are demo configuration for fixed report views, not telemetry or production access control.
Example V6 scores use mock page setup and mock video identity. No new activity rows, event times, contact-intent tags or staff/test flags are invented.
Scoring counts each distinct video once per attendee/page. Until contact buttons are classified, only saved products trigger the direct-ask HIGH rule.
Historical page configuration, staff/test cleanup and user-started video validation still need production decisions.
All metrics are recomputed from All Interactions; the repeated Attendee Details sheet is not imported.
